record.question: In which fetal presentation is the normal mechanism of labor often not possible?
record.explanation: Answer C: Brow presentation. A persistent brow presentation has a large presenting diameter and usually cannot undergo a normal vaginal mechanism unless it converts to vertex or face. Source/context note: Outcome depends on fetal size, pelvis, and whether presentation converts. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK470566/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
